title: Phishing Awareness
what_is_it: Phishing is a social engineering technique that attempts to trick people into revealing information or taking an unsafe action.
why_it_matters: Phishing can lead to credential theft, fraud, malware exposure, or unauthorized account access.
safe_practices: Verify unexpected requests using a trusted channel.
Do not disclose passwords or MFA codes.
Report suspicious messages through your organization's process.
if_something_happens: Stop interacting with the message and report it through the approved security or IT channel.

title: Password Security
what_is_it: Password security involves creating and protecting strong, unique authentication secrets.
why_it_matters: Password reuse can allow one compromised password to affect multiple accounts.
if_something_happens: Change the affected credential through the official account recovery process and report suspected compromise.

title: MFA and Passkeys
what_is_it: Multi-factor authentication adds another authentication factor beyond a password. Passkeys use modern cryptographic authentication.
why_it_matters: Additional authentication factors can reduce the impact of stolen passwords.
warning_signs: Requests to approve unknown login attempts
safe_practices: Never approve an unexpected authentication request.
if_something_happens: Deny unexpected authentication requests and report the event.

title: Social Engineering
what_is_it: Social engineering manipulates people into taking actions that may weaken security.
why_it_matters: Attackers may exploit trust, urgency, authority, or fear.
if_something_happens: Stop the interaction and report it through an approved channel.

title: Safe Browsing
what_is_it: Safe browsing means using websites and online services carefully and verifying unexpected requests.
why_it_matters: Unsafe browsing can expose users to scams, credential theft, or unwanted software.
safe_practices: Do not bypass security warnings without understanding them.
if_something_happens: Close the page and report suspicious activity if organizational systems are involved.

title: Secure Wi-Fi
what_is_it: Secure Wi-Fi uses appropriate authentication and encryption and avoids unnecessary exposure.
why_it_matters: Poorly secured networks can expose communications and devices to additional risk.
safe_practices: Use organizational VPN controls when required.
Avoid sensitive activity on unknown networks.
if_something_happens: Disconnect from suspicious networks and inform IT when appropriate.

title: Software Updates
what_is_it: Software updates fix defects and may address security vulnerabilities.
why_it_matters: Delayed patching can leave known weaknesses exposed.
warning_signs: Applications that are no longer receiving updates
if_something_happens: Report failed or suspicious update behavior to IT.

title: Ransomware Awareness
what_is_it: Ransomware is malicious activity that can disrupt access to systems or data, sometimes combined with data theft or extortion.
why_it_matters: Ransomware can cause operational downtime and data-access problems.
if_something_happens: Report suspected ransomware immediately and follow the organization's incident-response procedure.

title: USB and Removable Media
what_is_it: Removable media includes USB drives and external storage devices.
why_it_matters: Unknown devices can introduce security and data-loss risks.
if_something_happens: Disconnect only if safe and report the event to IT/security.

title: Data Privacy
what_is_it: Data privacy involves protecting personal, confidential, and sensitive information.
why_it_matters: Unnecessary disclosure can cause privacy, legal, and business risks.
safe_practices: Check recipients before sending sensitive data.

title: Mobile Security
what_is_it: Mobile security protects smartphones and tablets from unauthorized access and unsafe applications.
why_it_matters: Mobile devices can contain credentials, communications, and sensitive data.
if_something_happens: Report lost devices or suspected compromise through the approved process.

title: Remote Work Security
what_is_it: Remote work security protects systems and information while working outside normal organizational locations.
why_it_matters: Remote environments may involve unfamiliar networks and physical surroundings.
safe_practices: Protect sensitive information from unauthorized viewers.
if_something_happens: Report lost devices or suspected unauthorized access.

title: Cloud Account Security
what_is_it: Cloud account security protects identities, data, and access to cloud services.
why_it_matters: Compromised cloud accounts can expose large amounts of information.
if_something_happens: Report unexpected cloud account activity immediately.

title: Incident Reporting
what_is_it: Incident reporting means notifying the appropriate security or IT team about suspected security events.
why_it_matters: Early reporting can help defenders investigate and contain problems.
if_something_happens: Use the organization's approved security reporting mechanism.

title: AI-Enabled Scam Awareness
what_is_it: AI-enabled scams may use generated text, images, audio, or video to make deceptive communications appear convincing.
why_it_matters: Highly convincing content can make traditional visual clues less reliable.
if_something_happens: Stop and verify through a trusted channel.
